notes.title: Smile To Fly is out!
notes.content:
This day is a happy day - I am glad to present you Smile To Fly v1.0! 
I've made a big work last month fixing and improving the game features in the Early Access and now we are ready to be released!

So here is the short list of all changes comes into full version of the game.

Game:

 Implemented a tower defence system. Build and upgrade your weapon towers and survive waves to complete the game!
 UI redesigned, added goals panel and waves indicator. Also added a navigation panel to make camera movement even simpler.
 10 new achievements connected with tower defence waves.
 Spies now appears rarely and only on the border of the colony (from the enemy side).
 Various small changes and improves.


Bugfixes:

 Fixed issue with Cafe and Tea house after game loading.
 Fixed achievment bugs when resource-gain achievements sometimes were unavailable.
 Small UI bugfixes.
 Small text/translation improvments.

notes.title: Update to version 0.3.1
notes.content:
Hello! I am glad to present you our first regular update with new improvements, bug fixes and some additional content. Live version now is 0.3.1
Change log:

Improvements and chages:
1. New minigame added: fly on rocket and gather bonuses :)
2. Added sound volume setting (separately of music setting)
3. UI small changes.

Bug fixes:
1. Upgrade buildings bug fixed.
2. Problems with some buidlings prices fixed.
3. Small visual bugs fixed.
4. Other small technical improvements.

Thank you and have a nice day!

notes.title: Small Patch Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Decided to tell you more about bunch of recent small updates, which were caused by first impressions of players who already tried our Early Access version.
So here is a changelog:

1. Resources income was rebalanced: now electricity and gold mining work more effectively.
2. Some of the achievments was deleted. Soon they will be replaced by another.
3. Small bug fixes and technical improves.

Thank you and stay tuned - our first huge update is coming soon!
